mapper.sql: o.*, c.name AS customer_name, ct.name AS contact_name, u.nickname AS owner_name, cp.name AS campaign_name

FROM crm_opportunity o JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_contact ct ON ct.id = o.contact_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.owner_id LEFT JOIN crm_campaign cp ON cp.id = o.campaign_id
